title: Core-26 Canon Lock and Production Baseline
objective: Make the authoritative Core 26 roster mandatory for all future current-authority species work and establish one measurable production/certification standard and 26-row baseline for raising every core species to the same game-ready bar.
acceptance: CURRENT-referenced species-domain authority identifies exactly the Core 26 as current canon
startup/operating rules require domain consumers to load CURRENT-referenced domain authority before current species work
repository health validates Core-26 authority and rejects current-authority regression to 25 or legacy Nekron identity
one Core-26 game-ready standard defines the same certification dimensions for all 26 species
a 26-row baseline records existing evidence and gaps without treating historical 25-profile evidence as current certification
boundaries: MVPS-01 through MVPS-16 architecture remains completed_verified and is not reopened.
Historical PPIA/CAPP 25-species artifacts remain reproducible historical evidence; they cannot be used as current roster authority.
Morganthyr is current canon; Nekron/Nekrons are historical aliases only.
Akwi is a Core-26 peer regardless of supplemental physical storage.
Ratman remains one core species; its nine recovered lineages remain subordinate and source-bounded.
MVPS-17 establishes authority, standards and baseline only; it does not fabricate missing species lore/mechanics or claim all 26 are already certified.
next_action: On execution, implement the Core-26 current-canon authority pointer, forward-consumer enforcement, equal production standard, and 26-species baseline using TDD, then close to MVPS-18.
